title: Task contribution card hides earlier failed checks behind a later unrelated pass
observation: Reproduced on Hunch 1.40.1: Integration tests exit 7 followed by Lint exit 0 left only the passing lint on the text card, although JSON and HTML retained both. Fixed in the 1.41.0 candidate: the latest result per exact command argv determines unresolved failures, so unrelated passes and source edits do not clear them. A successful rerun of that command clears its failure. Candidate is in draft PR #396, not released.
evidence: test/task-report.test.ts: card keeps a failed command visible until that exact command succeeds; observed red before fix, green after fix.
2026-09-22: report/runner regression group passed 37 tests with 1 platform skip.
